title: Light Tunisian Coconut Wrap
description: A nutty and chewy Tunisian dish featuring custard powder and coconut cream, wrapped in a paleo-friendly corn husk wrap, perfect for kids. This dish is a delicious and healthy snack option.
instructions: Soak the corn husks in water for 30 minutes to make them pliable.
In a blender, combine coconut cream, custard powder, shredded coconut, almond butter, honey, vanilla extract, and salt, and blend until smooth.
To assemble the wraps, lay a corn husk flat and spread about 1/4 cup of the coconut mixture down the center of the husk.
Fold the bottom edge of the husk up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Repeat with the remaining corn husks and filling.
Serve the wraps immediately, or store them in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
To toast the wraps, place them on a baking sheet and bake in a preheated oven at 350 degrees for 5-7 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Let the wraps cool for a few minutes before serving.
